\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{আগামী} (āgāmī)}{আগামী (āgāmī)}]{\bn{আগামী} (āgāmī) — next, coming}

\label{lesson:BN-C146-agami}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for once, then the Bengali for to spend.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{আগামী}}
\textbf{\bn{আগামী}} — \emph{āgāmī} — \textquotedblleft{}next, coming\textquotedblright{}. Bengali's future adds \textbf{-\bn{ব}} for \textquotedblleft{}I\textquotedblright{}: \textbf{\bn{আমি} \bn{আগামী} \bn{সপ্তাহে} \bn{যাব}} — \emph{āmi āgāmī sôptāhe jābô} — \textquotedblleft{}I will go next week.\textquotedblright{}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{আগামী}} (\emph{āgāmī}) is Sanskrit \emph{āgāmin}, \textquotedblleft{}coming, future\textquotedblright{}, taken over whole as a learned loan, a tatsama.
\end{cousinweb}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{এরপর} (erpôr)}{এরপর (erpôr)}]{\bn{এরপর} (erpôr) — after this, from now on}

\label{lesson:BN-C146-erpor}

Before the new one: say the Bengali for to spend, then the Bengali for next.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{এরপর}}
\textbf{\bn{এরপর}} — \emph{erpôr} — \textquotedblleft{}after this, from now on\textquotedblright{}. It is \textbf{\bn{এর}}, \textquotedblleft{}of this\textquotedblright{}, with \textbf{\bn{পর}}, \textquotedblleft{}after\textquotedblright{}; add \textbf{\bn{থেকে}}, \textquotedblleft{}from\textquotedblright{}, for \textquotedblleft{}from now on\textquotedblright{}: \textbf{\bn{এরপর} \bn{থেকে} \bn{আমি} \bn{রোজ} \bn{হাঁটব}} — \emph{erpôr theke āmi roj hā̃ṭbô} — \textquotedblleft{}From now on I will walk every day.\textquotedblright{}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{এরপর}} (\emph{erpôr}) is \emph{er}, \textquotedblleft{}of this\textquotedblright{}, the near head \emph{e-} with the possessive \emph{-r}, + \emph{pôr}, \textquotedblleft{}after\textquotedblright{}, from Sanskrit \emph{para}, \textquotedblleft{}later\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 7793).
\end{cousinweb}
